visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with striking green-streaked hair faces the camera closely, her expression full of mock concern; she wears a black sleeveless top. The background is a well-lit indoor room featuring a large vintage wall clock and shelves. (2) The scene cuts to a digital screen showing hospital records with the text '40Y 4M' circled in red, followed by a cut to a home kitchen where an older woman with short permed hair smiles warmly while leaning on a table. (3) A brief clip shows a person in traditional religious attire (San Taizi) holding incense sticks over a table. (4) Back to the main character, she holds two black spherical skincare jars with silver lids, playfully covering her eyes like binoculars. She then applies the white cream to her cheek with a manicured finger. (5) She holds a realistic baby doll to compare skin texture, pointing at the doll's plump cheek while talking animatedly. (6) Close-ups of the skincare jar reveal the 'HR' logo and technical text. Graphic overlays of flowers and text bubbles appear around her face as she demonstrates the lifting effect on her jawline.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice asking a rhetorical question about age, accompanied by a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic background track. A sharp 'Whoosh' sound effect marks the first visual transition. (2) The narration shifts into a story-telling mode, mimicking different characters' voices. Frequent 'Ding' sound effects coincide with text appearing on screen. (3) As the product is introduced, the music swells slightly, and a 'Sparkle' or 'Magic' SFX is heard to emphasize the luxury brand. (4) During the technical explanation of 'PX50', the vocal tone becomes more professional and articulated, while the rhythmic beat of the BGM keeps the pace high. (5) A comical 'Pop' sound is heard when the baby doll is mentioned, followed by a continuous stream of descriptive speech and rhythmic BGM until the final endorsement.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict/Aging jokes -> Solution/Product Intro -> Technical Proof -> Result Demo -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous hook about varying perceptions of the creator's age to introduce the Helena Rubinstein Re-Plasty skincare line. It aims to persuade viewers that high-quality, high-concentration 'Black Bandage' cream is the secret to maintaining youthful, baby-like skin despite chronological age.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of product jars, mention of brand name HR, and detailed explanation of product benefits and patents.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production-value social media advertisement using 'variety show' style editing and humorous storytelling to engage the audience before delivering technical product information.
